blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense lawyers on Wednesday played old remarks from the late Senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago criticizing prosecutors who dropped impeachment articles during the trial of late Chief Justice Renato Corona. Defense lawyer Mark Vinluan presented the video during the testimony of former Anti-Money Laundering Council Secretariat investigator Reinel dela Fuente of the Compliance and Investigation Group. At that time, Santiago questioned the House prosecutors during Corona’s impeachment trial, asking whether they had withdrawn the articles of impeachment to conduct a trial by publicity.
